correctness.rationale: Disk Toeplitz eigenvalues are λ_n=1−e^(−x)Σ_{j=0}^n x^j/j! with a strict gap between the top-2 cluster and complement. Differentiating exact squared-radius monomial moments yields the V,W entries, and trace-norm smoothness follows from integrating coherent-state projectors at positive radius. The contour/resolvent isolated-cluster formula has the correct n=0,1 to m>=2 couplings, producing two positive Poisson ratios plus boundary term −x e^(−x)|hhat_k|². The k=1 cancellation matches translations, and falling-factorial denominators strictly increase in k. Independent numerical rational/symbolic evaluations at x=.2,1,3,25 confirmed H2 and monotone coefficient ordering; the submitted matrix quadrature code was inspected but not trusted as proof.

final_claim: At the Gaussian Bargmann–Fock disk of squared radius x>0 and area πx, the second-order rank-two Ky Fan localization eigenvalue sum for all mean-zero C² radial-graph perturbations is e^(−x) Σ_{k≥2} H_k(x)|hhat_k|². The Fourier Hessian has only k=±1 translational zero directions; H_k<0 strictly decreases, H2=−x(2x+3)/((x+2)(x+3)), and the least negative curvature occurs at second harmonics.
limitations: No global quantitative deficit or shape theorem for arbitrary measurable domains.
